Learn moreSign in Comments Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description Kennesaw State's historic football turnaround #WABENews #collegefootball 38Likes1,666ViewsDec 42025 The Kennesaw State University Owls football team is on the verge of a historic program turnaround. Beginning last season, KSU made the jump to the Football Bowl Subdivision, or FBS — college football’s highest level. With the promotion came struggle. The Owls finished with a 2-and-10 record. Kennesaw State began its year with consecutive losses to Wake Forest and No. 2-ranked Indiana. But they finished their 2025 regular season with a 9-3 record (7-1 conference).
